CONGRANT.TITLE: ONBOARDING FRESHMAN BOOSTCAMPS FOR ACADEMIC SUCCESS
CONGRANT.AWARDORG: The University of Texas Rio Grande Valley
CONGRANT.ABSTRACT: We propose enhancing and expanding the successful Onboarding Freshman Boostcamp program. The expected impact is that participant students will increase their first-year retention rates by up to 75%. This is of great significance since the first year is critical for student's success.

SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.DESC:
The C.E.MENTor program allows students an opportunity to shadow and/or be mentored by professionals in a “real-world” working environment. The program was introduced in the Fall of 2019 by Professor Jorge Vidal as an opportunity for students to get a better idea of what awaits for them in the professional world of Civil Engineering while allowing participant students to network and develop important soft-skills like communication and other critical professional skills. The program consists of pairing interested students with volunteer professionals and/or organizations within the AEC industry (Architecture, Engineering and Construction).

As a faculty coordinator, following are the duties:

a) To appoint student coordinator (s)
b) To secure internships for student coordinator (s)
c) To develop and promote the program
d) To develop networking and marketing schedule and plan amongst the industry professionals
e) To find new industry partners to grow the program
To share accomplishments of our students and program through social media
SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.ACCOMPLISH:
In Fall 2025, 75 students registered for the C.E.MENTor program and about 55 students took advantage of the program and connected with the industry professionals

We started with 4 industry partners and at the end of Fall 2025 we had about 12-15 industry partners who joined our program
